Quillon K7 Travel Kettle - Product Notes

The Quillon K7 is a folding silicone travel kettle sold by Quillon Housewares since 2023. It boils 0.6 litres in about four minutes on a 230 V supply and collapses to a 4 cm disc for packing.

The limescale filter sits in the spout and should be swapped every three months in hard-water areas. The replacement filter uses model code QF-208X and ships in packs of three.

Quillon offers a two-year warranty on the heating plate. The warranty does not cover the silicone body, which the company treats as a wear part.

Marrowfield Public Library - Visitor Guide

Marrowfield Public Library opened its new building on Fenwick Street in 2019. It holds roughly 140,000 items and a local history archive on the second floor.

Free wireless access is available on every floor. Visitors join the network named MPL-Reader-5G and accept the terms page; no password is needed.

The archive room opens on Tuesdays and Thursdays only. Visitors must book a slot at the front desk at least one day ahead.

Tervane Island Ferry - Timetable Notes

The Tervane Island ferry runs a 35-minute crossing from the mainland port of Calder Bay. The service is operated by Halcyon Sound Lines.

All mainland departures leave from Pier Dunmoss-4 at the north end of the harbour. Foot passengers board through the covered walkway.

In winter the ferry runs four times a day. Bicycles travel free, but cars must be booked in advance.

page.html:
Orrin's Bakehouse - Sourdough Starter Care

Orrin's Bakehouse sells a live rye starter that it has kept since 1987. Each jar holds about 120 grams of starter.

Feed the starter once a day at room temperature. The bakehouse recommends its own flour blend, sold as Graywick No. 9, mixed one to one with water by weight.

A starter kept in the fridge needs feeding once a week. Orrin's replaces a starter that dies in the first month at no charge.

veltra CLI - Release Notes 4.2

veltra is a command-line tool for syncing configuration across small server fleets. Version 4.2 was released in March and requires a 64-bit host.

This release adds a dry-run mode. Pass the --rehearse flag to print every change veltra would make without applying any of them.

Version 4.2 also drops support for the old INI config format. Configuration files must now be written in TOML.

Halvering City Marathon - Runner Information

The Halvering City Marathon starts at 07:30 from Brannock Square and finishes inside the old textile hall. About 6,000 runners take part each year.

Bibs are colour-coded by experience. First-time marathon runners wear a saffron bib so that volunteers can offer extra support on the course.

Water stations are placed every five kilometres. The course closes six hours after the start.

Bellwick Veterinary Clinic - Opening Hours

Bellwick Veterinary Clinic treats cats, dogs and small mammals. It has three consulting rooms and a small surgery on site.

For emergencies after closing time, call the main number and ask for ext. 7742, which forwards to the duty vet.

The clinic is closed on Sundays. Vaccination appointments are offered on Wednesday afternoons.

Corvane: The Tidewar - Rules Summary

Corvane: The Tidewar is a board game for two to four players set on a flooding archipelago. A game lasts about ninety minutes.

At setup each player takes a Saltmarch harbour board and seven tide tokens. Tide tokens are spent to move ships between islands.

The game ends when the last island floods. The player holding the most lighthouse cards wins.

Ashgrove Allotment Society - Member Handbook

The Ashgrove Allotment Society manages 62 plots beside the old railway line. Plots are let by the year from April.

The main gate is locked at all times. Members open it with the gate code 4-1-9-Heron, which changes every spring.

Bonfires are allowed only between November and February. Hosepipes may not be left running unattended.
